title: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher’s fusion power startup. Here’s what they’re building.
summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is backing Europa Fusion, a fusion power startup founded by an AI researcher. Here's what the startup is building.
llm_summary: Spotify co‑founder Daniel Ek has invested in Europa Fusion, a new startup founded by an AI researcher that aims to accelerate the development of commercial fusion energy. The company is leveraging advanced AI‑driven design and simulation tools to create compact, cost‑effective fusion reactors that could bring clean, abundant power to market far sooner than traditional approaches.
